### An image generation prompt resembling a smartphone snapshot of three Japanese women playing in the shallow waters of Enoshima.

Author：[@HObE4TLMga99335](https://x.com/HObE4TLMga99335) · [Source](https://x.com/HObE4TLMga99335/status/2101647060357222565)

Photography · Published

Source：[@HObE4TLMga99335](https://x.com/HObE4TLMga99335) · [Source](https://x.com/HObE4TLMga99335/status/2101189292827779362)

**Summary:** An image generation prompt resembling a smartphone snapshot of three Japanese women playing in the shallow waters of Enoshima.

<img src="images/2101647060357222565-1.jpg" alt="Image 1" width="480" />

<img src="images/2101647060357222565-2.jpg" alt="Image 2" width="480" />

<img src="images/2101647060357222565-3.jpg" alt="Image 3" width="480" />

**Prompt**

```text
Character Identity:
Female 1 is a 22-year-old adult Japanese woman, 168 cm tall, a 4th-year computer science student. Vertically elongated heart-shaped face, wide almond eyes, arched eyebrows, a small mole on her right cheek, and completely straight black hair reaching below the bust. Female 2 is a 30-year-old adult Japanese woman, 166 cm tall, a bakery cafe manager. Soft round-oval face, faint freckles on her nose, a mole below the outer corner of her left eye, dimples when smiling. Black shoulder-length bob with gray only around the ears and the inner lower layers. Removes her glasses at the sea. Female 3 is a 23-year-old adult Japanese woman, 152 cm tall, a nail technician. Small round face, drooping/downturned eyes, a mole under her right eye, black hair tied in low twin tails with dusty pink only on the inner tips. Maintain the adult facial features and natural full-body proportions of the three, without blending characteristics between distinct individuals.

Hairstyles:
Female 1's long, straight black hair reaching below the bust is tied into a single ponytail at the back of her head. Preserving its length and straight texture, the wet long hair does not cover her face or the front of her torso. Female 2's shoulder-length straight bob is tied into a small, low ponytail at the nape of the neck, with short strands that do not reach tucked behind her ears. The crown, outer surface, and roots remain black, leaving smoky gray only on the inner sides behind the ears and the tips below the tie. Do not lengthen Female 2's hair or form it into a large bun. Female 3 maintains her black low twin tails with dusty pink on the inner tips.

Outfits:
Female 1 wears a light blue, Female 2 a charcoal, and Female 3 a dusty pink completely closed, opaque short-sleeve rash guard. Each is worn over an opaque athletic swimsuit, covering the chest, abdomen, and shoulders. Female 1 and Female 3 wear navy, and Female 2 wears black above-the-knee swim shorts. Barefoot. Outfits must not be translucent or removed.

Scene and Composition:
A single continuous horizontal 3:2 photograph. In the shallow waters of the Enoshima sea in the afternoon. Do not arrange the three side-by-side or equally spaced like a commemorative photo lineup. The three stand in a small triangle in the calm shallows, facing toward each other. Female 1, closer in the foreground to the left, is in a near three-quarter profile, flicking a small splash of water with one hand toward Female 3 in the right background. Her other hand rests naturally near the water surface. Female 1's face is angled almost in profile, smiling as she looks at her friend. Female 3, slightly deeper in the background to the right, uses a pale pink swim ring, holding its rim with her left hand and lightly raising her right forearm in mild surprise at Female 1's small splash. She narrows her eyes slightly in laughter, but her face remains clearly visible. Female 2, next to Female 3 and further back toward the center of the frame, lightly supports the far edge of Female 3's swim ring with one hand, playing along. Female 2's other arm hangs naturally at her side into the water. Female 2 is smiling as she watches Female 3. There is depth between the heads and shoulders of the three; Female 1's shoulder naturally overlaps a very small part of Female 3's swim ring, but avoid overlapping that obscures ownership of faces or hands. There is only one pink swim ring belonging to Female 3. Do not give swim rings to Female 1 or Female 2, and do not depict blue-and-white or yellow rings.

Shot Style:
A smartphone snapshot taken from an oblique angle without interrupting the friends' play. No one looks at the camera. Leave margin overhead and to the left and right, capturing the upper bodies of the three, Female 3's single swim ring, the fact that everyone is in the water, and the foreground water surface. Do not create parallel shoulder lines or even spacing. The three are positioned close enough for conversation, staggered in depth by roughly 1 meter each. A single AF plane near Female 1's face in the foreground; the two in the back may be slightly softer following natural distance falloff, yet their features and actions remain distinguishable. There is localized slight motion blur on water droplets and moving hands, without artificially sharpening only the skin and faces.

Background and Lighting:
Calm blue-green sea, a soft-focused distant coastline and Enoshima, natural afternoon daylight. Weak reflections from the water surface reach clothing and faces, while hair shadows remain.

Required and Excluded Elements:
Seawater reaches from thigh to around waist height, and the feet of all three touch the seabed. Only small water splashes; no large waves, diving, falling, or hazardous actions. Accurately depict contact between arms and the swim ring, with two arms and two hands per person. No duplicated faces or arms, and no merging of bodies with the swim ring. Coastline and Enoshima visible in the background. Do not add text, logos, or split screens.

Fixed Photorealistic Quality:
A single, near-raw HEIC photo taken with a standard smartphone camera app. Do not use portrait mode, beauty filters, face-only relighting, exposure correction, resharpening, noise reduction, or skin smoothing. AF is placed only on the single plane specified in the camera section, rendering that plane most naturally clear, while figures, limbs, props, and background before and behind it soften progressively according to distance and movement. Do not apply fake pores or global 8K sharpness to distant faces; retain broad tonal variations such as faint redness on one cheek, uneven T-zone highlights, asymmetrical under-eye areas, and mild redness around the nose. On resolving exposed skin nearby, retain non-repeating subtle skin tone shifts, natural redness at joints and pressure points, and fine shading. Render skin, hair, fabric, metal, wood, walls, and water with distinct material-specific reflections, edges, and textures, rather than uniform gloss or uniform sharpness. Allow modest HDR, subtle AWB variations, fine noise limited to shadow areas, slight HEIC compression, and mild localized hand-shake or framing deviation, but avoid full-frame fake grain, uniform blur, or over-sharpening. Let it exist as an unpolished, authentic moment preserved in a personal camera roll, avoiding any resemblance to an advertisement, gravure, fashion campaign, studio beauty photography, cinematic color grading, or perfect symmetrical composition.
```

```text
Character Identities:
Woman 1: Fictional adult Japanese woman, 22 years old, 4th-year student in Computer Science. Height 168 cm, with long legs and good posture, sporting a naturally realistic glamorous physique. Natural weight and width balancing her ribcage, a realistic waist, and pelvis and hips balancing her legs. No pushing up or artificial emphasis on body parts. Long-ish heart-shaped face, high cheekbones, slender jaw, subtle double-eyelid horizontal almond eyes with slightly upturned outer corners, high arched eyebrows, a thin straight nose with a sharp tip, and full lips. Untanned light neutral skin, with a single small mole placed high on her right cheek. Long layered black hair, completely straight down past her chest. Honey brown irises, thin winged eyeliner, coral beige lips, thin gold hoops. Known for a confident smile showing her teeth, though prioritizing the scene-specified expression without repeating identical facial expressions.
Woman 2: Fictional adult Japanese woman, 30 years old, bakery cafe manager. 166 cm with long legs, healthy realistic hourglass figure. Natural weight and width balancing her ribcage, a realistic waist, and slightly rounded hips transitioning naturally from the pelvis to the upper thighs. No extreme wasp-waists, spherical busts, or exaggerated hips. Compact rounded oval face, soft cheeks and a rounded jaw, large double-eyelid round-leaning almond dark brown eyes, very subtle droop at the outer corners, soft arched eyebrows, natural nasal bridge with a rounded tip, full lips. No center part, no gray outer surface hair. Taupe eye makeup, rose beige lips, thin silver hoops. Round, thin black-rimmed glasses. Vivid, context-appropriate expression.
Woman 3: Fictional adult Japanese woman, 23 years old, nail artist. 152 cm petite, soft adult figure, natural build, realistic shoulders and ribcage, waist, proportional pelvis and hips, adult limb proportions. Small round face, large dark brown droopy eyes, short parallel eyebrows, small nose, soft lips, light neutral skin, a single small mole under her right eye. Glossy black medium-length hair tied in low twin tails. Dusty pink highlights only on the inner layer of the tips, black roots and crown. Mature pink-toned eye makeup, not white-painted. Known for a bashful closed-mouth smile. Follows specified variations such as hair being tied up in the morning and untied upon returning home. Not a minor, no school uniforms, no cosplay.
Do not mix up the faces, ages, hair, body types, moles, outfits, or personal belongings of the three individuals. Do not have all three tilting their heads with identical smiles. Do not depict the petite Woman 3 as a child. Maintain the described facial and physical characteristics without advertising-style post-processing.

Scene: Looking Back at Photos in a Bar
A quiet, calm small bar at night. Three adult women are sitting together on a sofa booth, leaning in towards a smartphone held in one hand by Woman 2 in the center, reviewing photos taken at the beach earlier that day. Woman 2's other hand points at a specific spot on the screen. On the left side of the frame, Woman 1 raises her face slightly, unable to hold back her laughter. On the right, Woman 3 leans lightly against Woman 2's shoulder, wearing a shy, closed-mouth smile at her own picture. The contents of the smartphone screen cannot be read in detail due to angle and glare. Three cocktail glasses are placed on the table; they are not holding them up for a toast. Shot on a smartphone standard 1x camera from about 1.7 meters away, taken by a bar employee. The faces, shoulders, hands, and glasses of all three are captured. Single autofocus locked on Woman 2's face in the center. Warm overhead and wall lighting, with the background slightly darker. Warm tones are kept from looking overly cinematic, preserving subtle noise in the shadows and natural exposure differences.

Outfits:
Woman 1 wears a fitted, opaque white sleeveless top, blue denim shorts, comfortable white walking sneakers, thin gold hoop earrings, and a smartwatch. Woman 2 wears an opaque charcoal sleeveless top, lightweight black wide-leg trousers, flat sandals, thin silver hoop earrings, and round black-rimmed glasses. Woman 3 wears an opaque black sleeveless top with a small bow, dusty pink culottes, and comfortable black walking sandals.

Composition:
Horizontal 3:2 aspect ratio, a single continuous photograph. All three share the same space. No splits, collages, borders, names, or text. The main subjects are exclusively Woman 1, Woman 2, and Woman 3—three people in total.

Consistent Photorealistic Quality:
A near-unedited single HEIC photo captured on a regular smartphone's default camera app. No portrait mode, beauty filters, face-specific relighting, exposure correction, re-sharpening, noise reduction, or skin smoothing. Single AF placed strictly on the plane specified in the camera section, making that focal plane naturally the sharpest, while subjects, limbs, props, and background in front of or behind it progressively soften according to distance and motion. No synthetic pores or uniform 8K sharpness added to distant faces; multiple broad tonal variations are preserved, such as faint redness on one cheek, non-uniform T-zone glare, asymmetric under-eye areas, and mild redness around the nose. Exposed skin close to the camera retains non-repetitive subtle skin tone variations, natural redness around joints or pressure points, and micro-shadows. Skin, hair, fabric, metal, wood, walls, and water each possess distinct reflections, edge definitions, and textures corresponding to their materials, avoiding uniform gloss or uniform sharpness. Modest HDR, slight AWB discrepancies, micro-noise restricted to shadows, subtle HEIC compression, and localized slight hand shake or misframing are allowed, avoiding artificial full-frame grain, blanket blurring, or excessive sharpening. Functions as an unpolished, authentic moment kept in a private camera roll; not an advertisement, gravure, fashion campaign, studio beauty shot, cinematic color grade, or perfectly symmetrical composition.

Mandatory and Negative Constraints: Each individual has one head, face, and torso, with anatomically connected two arms and two legs. Hands clearly show contact with their owner and props. Avoid extra people, duplicated figures, homogenized faces, swapped faces/hair/outfits, extra or missing limbs, fused fingers, unnatural palms, hands clipping through objects, floating items, flipped left-right features, minors, juvenile representations of adults, school uniforms, real-life figures, explicit nudity, see-through clothing, visible underwear, isolated cropped body parts, readable text, logos, watermarks, anime, CGI, identical smiles, identical head tilts, and everyone looking straight into the camera simultaneously.

<a name="prompt-2101665636380475723"></a>

### A detailed photorealistic prompt depicting a Japanese woman sitting on a bed in a bedroom on a rainy night, wearing white lingerie with delicate floral embroidery.

Author：[@muse\_ai\_prompt](https://x.com/muse_ai_prompt) · [Source](https://x.com/muse_ai_prompt/status/2101665636380475723)

Photography · Character · Published

**Summary:** A detailed photorealistic prompt depicting a Japanese woman sitting on a bed in a bedroom on a rainy night, wearing white lingerie with delicate floral embroidery.

<img src="images/2101665636380475723-1.jpg" alt="Image 1" width="480" />

**Prompt**

```text
🌟A Night Wrapped in the Sound of Rain | White Embroidered Lingerie and a Gentle Smile🌟

[Subject & Art Style]
Depict an adult Japanese woman sitting on a bed in a bedroom on a heavily raining night. Clothed in white lingerie with small floral embroidery, capturing a peaceful, intimate moment just before saying "good night" to her lover. The composition should naturally convey not only the woman's charm, but also the quietness and lived-in warmth unique to a rainy night.
The art style is grounded in photorealism, combining the premium quality of a photo book page with the atmospheric mood of a cinematic scene. Rather than an overly staged gravure style, it should be a lived-in photographic expression with a natural sense of distance and interior warmth, as if taken with a real camera.

[Location, Background & Worldview]
The location is a modern bedroom with a large window. In the center is a white bed with plump white pillows and a soft white duvet featuring natural folds and creases. While clean, the area around the bed has a gentle disarray from having been slightly used, evoking a realistic pre-sleep atmosphere.
Right beside the bed is a large closed window with curtains drawn open to the left and right. Droplets of various sizes cling to the windowpane, with several rivulets of rainwater streaming downward. Outside the window, a balcony railing and puddles on the balcony floor are visible, showing dense streaks of rain falling diagonally, illuminated by streetlights. The background is moderately tidy so that the location and weather are immediately understood without distracting from the main subject.

[Season, Time & Weather]
The seasonal feel is a night during a time when the comfort of rain sounds leaves an impression rather than muggy heat. The time is completely after sundown, with a deep blue nightscape outside. Inside is a time for relaxation, with the quiet afterglow before sleep.
The weather is distinctly heavy rain. The volume of rain outside the window should be clearly noticeable, conveying the humidity and heavy air characteristic of a rainy night through streaks of rain lit by streetlights and ambient outdoor light, water droplets, and puddle reflections. However, the interior, the subject, and the bedding remain dry, creating a comforting space in contrast to the rain outside.

[Character Setting]
The subject is a distinctly adult Japanese woman around 27 years old. She has soft, well-balanced facial features, combining approachable mature cuteness with calm elegance. Large, dark-eyed gaze, natural eyebrows, well-complexioned lips, and subtly rounded cheeks, creating a face whose natural charm is evident even at an intimate distance.
Her hair is dark brown, falling to her shoulders with natural soft waves. Her skin has a fair, light-ochre tone, maintaining a natural texture that is not overly smooth and a subtle healthy glow. Her build is a naturally glamorous figure harmonizing slender shoulders, delicate limbs, a narrow waist, and feminine curves. Her bust is clearly large with generous volume, rendered with a soft three-dimensionality shaped by her garment, posture, and gravity, maintaining overall proportion with her body.

[Outfit & Accessories]
The outfit is a white bra and panty set. Delicate white small floral embroidery is featured throughout, with elegant lace along the edges. Small satin ribbons are placed at the front center and waistline, creating a design that feels mature and lovely with a touch of sweetness without being childish. The main parts of the cups and panties are lined with opaque white fabric, achieving both a clean aesthetic and realistic wearability.
The sizing focuses on a realistic fit that naturally hugs her full bust and hips. The fabric must not float away from the body, dig in excessively, or appear unnaturally stretched. Accessories are kept minimal, limited to at most small stud earrings if necessary, prioritizing a natural bedtime look.

[Pose, Action & Gaze]
The woman sits slightly forward from the center of the bed, with her upper body facing the camera while her entire body is angled slightly diagonally. Both legs are neatly together, flowing naturally toward the bottom left of the frame, with knees softly bent and her bare feet resting comfortably on the white bedsheets. Her weight is lightly supported by her left hand to stabilize her, forming a relaxed seated posture.
Her left hand rests on the mattress slightly behind her body to support her upper torso, while her right hand gently rests on the sheet beside her thigh. Neither hand is holding anything, and her fingertips are in a relaxed, natural state. With relaxed shoulders and her head tilted very slightly, she looks toward her lover at the camera position. Her gaze is direct and soft, conveying an intimate, unforced tenderness.

[Expression & Emotion]
Her expression is a calm, gentle smile at the moment she is about to say "good night" before going to sleep. Her eyes are soft, eyebrows naturally relaxed, and lips curve into a warm, subtle smile. Rather than an exaggerated grin, it is an expression that conveys how much she enjoys spending time with the person before her.
Centering on emotions of security, warmth, and intimacy. Amid the quietness of a rainy night, it exudes a serene sense of happiness, as if cherishing this moment before falling asleep together with her lover. Emphasizing a natural tenderness without being overly flirtatious.

[Composition & Camera]
A 4:5 vertical portrait composition suited for X posts. A full-body composition that comfortably frames her entire body from head to toe, leaving a little breathing room above her head and past her feet. Maintaining a distance that naturally showcases her overall posture and how she sits on the bed. The woman is positioned slightly to the right of center, incorporating the large window on the left or in the background to show both the interior and the rainy scene outside.
The camera is angled slightly in front of the bed at an eye-level height that naturally captures the woman's face and outfit from the front. The viewpoint is neither too high nor too low, close to a natural eye level relative to a seated person. The focal length is standard to slightly moderate telephoto, avoiding unnatural distortion of the body or face. The background is lightly uncluttered yet retains enough detail to show the rain on the window and the texture of the bedding.

[Lighting, Color, Texture & Atmosphere]
The primary light source is a warm bedside lamp. Its soft light gently illuminates the woman's face, décolletage, arms, legs, and white bedding, creating serene shadows. Subordinately, bluish night light enters from outside the window, producing a natural contrast between the warm interior and cool exterior tones. Shadows are soft, maintaining a calm, three-dimensional ambiance typical of a nighttime room.
Depict the fluffy thickness and wrinkles of the white bedding, the delicate texture of the embroidery and lace on the lingerie, the natural complexion and soft shading on her skin, and fine strands with gentle sheen in her hair. Raindrops on the window, cascading rivulets, and reflections on the wet balcony floor and railing are also rendered with care, resulting in an overall cinematic yet lived-in atmosphere where warmth and quiet coexist.

[Quality & Negative Elements]
High resolution, emphasizing natural human anatomy, lighting, textures, and perspective as if photographed with a real camera. The subject is distinctly depicted as an adult Japanese woman; avoid childish appearances or ambiguous ages. Limbs, finger count, joint orientations, contact of feet with surfaces, and outfit construction must be natural and structurally sound.
Avoid extra limbs or fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, unnatural joints, clothing fusing with the body, distorted garments, unintended nudity, extreme wide-angle distortion, excessive skin-smoothing retouching, and unnatural background handling. While maintaining generous, natural volume, the bust should not appear as rigid spheres, be unnaturally pushed up, or defy gravity. No text, logos, watermarks, or UI elements in the image.
```

The background softly blurs typical hotel elements such as a simple headboard, a small bedside table, and an understated lamp. Without cluttering props, the space is neatly organized around the white bedding and window light, creating a quiet environment where the person's face and attire naturally take center stage.

[Season / Time / Weather]
The season is a mild period reminiscent of spring to early summer. The time is early morning around 7:00 AM, with the outdoors beginning to brighten. A clear morning, but without harsh direct sunlight, allowing soft light diffused by lace curtains to spread through the room.
The room retains the slightly cool, crisp air characteristic of the morning, and the light falling across the bedding ranges from white to pale cream. The color temperature remains gentle, maintaining freshness without appearing cold.

[Character Setting]
A distinctly adult 24-year-old Japanese woman. Soft and well-proportioned facial features with slightly large, dark-toned eyes, natural eyebrows, a slender nose bridge, and soft, naturally flushed lips. Dark brown hair reaching slightly past the shoulders, showing slight, natural morning bedhead and soft waves, with delicate wisps of hair framing the face.
Fair ochre-toned skin with realistic textures, retaining pores and subtle shading. Delicate shoulders and arms, paired with a slender waist and feminine curves that harmonize into a naturally glamorous figure. A distinctly full and voluptuous bust, portrayed with soft, natural dimension conforming to gravity and her reclining posture against the bedding, without stiffness or unnatural push-up effects.

[Attire / Accessories]
An elegant ivory bra and panty set reminiscent of Wacoal styles. The composition mainly shows the bra portion, keeping the panties outside the frame. The cup surfaces are scattered with delicate floral embroidery in soft apricot and beige tones, finished with fine scalloped lace along the upper edge.
The cups feature an opaque lining that prevents skin from showing through, avoiding overly sheer fabric. No accessories are worn, prioritizing morning simplicity and cleanliness.

[Pose / Action / Gaze]
The woman gently props up her upper body, using the white pillows to support her back up to the shoulder blades. Her lips remain lightly closed without opening wide or carrying tension. A faint morning flush warms her cheeks—not an artificial smile, but a genuine smile naturally spilling over upon looking at someone dear. Balancing adult composure and approachable warmth without exaggerated sweetness.

[Composition / Camera]
A 4:5 vertical portrait composition tailored for X (formerly Twitter) posts. A bust-up shot capturing from the chest up to the crown of the head, leaving slight headroom. A close-up framing where facial expressions, eyes, lips, and the ivory floral embroidery are all clearly visible simultaneously.
The camera is positioned roughly at the woman's eye level, slightly off-center to the front, using a natural focal length equivalent to a 50–85mm standard to short telephoto lens. [Lighting / Color / Texture / Atmosphere]

### Structured prompt template for doorbell infrared night vision surveillance footage, designed to generate videos of uncanny visitors.

Author：[@Gdgtify](https://x.com/Gdgtify) · [Source](https://x.com/Gdgtify/status/2100153971088482321)

Photography · Published

**Summary:** Structured prompt template for doorbell infrared night vision surveillance footage, designed to generate videos of uncanny visitors.

<img src="covers/2100153971088482321.jpg" alt="Image 1" width="480" />

**Prompt**

```text
INPUT: $ SUBJECT              // cryptid, unclassified figure, something wrong at the door
VISITOR   = infer_subject($ SUBJECT)        // scale vs doorframe, posture, awareness of lens
BEHAVIOR  = infer_mundane_act($ SUBJECT)    // it is doing something ORDINARY — trash, doorknob, package
PORCH     = infer_porch($ SUBJECT)          // real siding, mat, planter, hose, peeling paint
NIGHT     = infer_ir_night($ SUBJECT)       // IR emitters on, monochrome, no color info
BLOWOUT   = infer_ir_falloff($ SUBJECT)     // near subject blown white, background crushed black
LENS      = infer_fisheye($ SUBJECT)        // heavy barrel warp, corners stretched
MOUNT     = infer_camera_height($ SUBJECT)  // ~4ft, fixed, slightly off-level
CROP      = infer_motion_trigger($ SUBJECT) // subject partly out of frame — cut off, entering
OVERLAY   = infer_hud($ SUBJECT)            // timestamp, device name, battery icon, small font
FLAWS     = infer_flaws($ SUBJECT)          // low bitrate smear, IR noise, compression blocks
Φ = ir_falloff(emitter) + barrel_warp(LENS)
MOTION: subject enters frame at edge → pauses → head turns toward lens → holds 2s → exits.
No camera movement, fixed mount.
Compose: fixed doorbell camera, IR night mode, monochrome, subject overexposed and
partially cropped, timestamp overlay, heavy compression. Photoreal, 4:3 or 16:9.
```

Author：[@liluocheng13](https://x.com/liluocheng13) · [Source](https://x.com/liluocheng13/status/2100505656231096481)

Comic / Graphic Novel · Ink / Chinese Style · Animal / Creature · Landscape / Nature · Published

**Summary:** Ancient Song Dynasty ink-wash landscape style, featuring a traditional Gongbi grey wolf in the lower right corner with a silly, innocent expression and a tilted-head smile, with calligraphy and a vermilion seal in the upper left.

<img src="images/2100505656231096481-1.jpg" alt="Image 1" width="480" />

**Prompt**

```text
Vertical composition, 9:16 aspect ratio. An ancient ink-wash landscape painting that looks as though it was retrieved from an imperial archive of the Song Dynasty, with a rather solemn and grandiose atmosphere: distant peaks tower into the clouds, mist slowly drifts across the mountainsides, bizarre pines stand on cliffs, while withered branches and scattered rocks are dispersed across the foreground, accompanied by abundant negative space, as if heaven and earth were solemnly debating some monumental affair of the ages. However, in the lower right of the painting, there stands a distinctly un-serious grey wolf. Its body shape and fur are still meticulously depicted according to traditional fine-brush ink-wash techniques (Gongbi), with accurate limb anatomy, a naturally drooping tail, and perked-up ears; yet its head is tilted slightly, its eyes are wide and round, and a goofy, polite faint smile hangs at the corners of its mouth, wearing an expression as if it just stole a snack and is trying hard to act like: "It wasn't me, I'm just passing through." Innocent yet guilty, with a hint of inexplicable confidence, adorably earnest, and high-class goofy. The overall style combines Song Dynasty ink-wash landscapes with ancient animal paintings, featuring rich gradations of ink, combining wet-brush washes and dry-brush texture strokes (cun). The wolf's fur is delicate yet maintains hand-painted brushstrokes; the mountain rocks are heavy, and the clouds and mist are ethereal. Old Xuan paper backdrop, warm beige tones with faint tea-stain effects, showing natural mottling, creases, and traces of age. In the upper left, the inscription "子丹图画" is written vertically in archaic running script, accompanied by a small vermilion seal below. At first glance, the entire painting appears to be an ancient masterpiece; at second glance, the wolf seems off; at third glance, one cannot help but laugh out loud. The scene is humorous without being juvenile, cute without resembling a cartoon sticker; it preserves the subtlety, negative space, and refined aesthetic of traditional Oriental painting. No modern items, no exaggerated chibi heads, no anime style, no 3D rendering, no plastic texture, no fierce expressions, no gore, no extra limbs, no incorrect paws, no garbled text. Ultra-fine traditional hand-painted texture, museum-grade ancient painting reproduction effect, 9:16 aspect ratio.
```

<a name="prompt-2097951816675639459"></a>

### A 15-second early-2000s documentary scene where a reporter interviews an alien near a landed spaceship, and the alien reveals it came to Earth to redeem a McDonald's coupon.

Author：[@DtheW1995](https://x.com/DtheW1995) · [Source](https://x.com/DtheW1995/status/2097951816675639459)

Cyberpunk / Sci-Fi · Published

**Summary:** A 15-second early-2000s documentary scene where a reporter interviews an alien near a landed spaceship, and the alien reveals it came to Earth to redeem a McDonald's coupon.

<img src="covers/2097951816675639459.jpg" alt="Image 1" width="480" />

**Prompt**

```text
15-second ultra-realistic early-2000s television documentary footage, filmed on a consumer MiniDV camera by one physically present cameraman. Nighttime in a damp field outside a small American town. A large authentic metallic alien spacecraft has just landed behind the subjects, resting heavily in flattened wet grass; its ramp is open, pale interior light spills into the fog, condensation drips from the hull and a low mechanical hum is audible. No cinematic polish: shaky shoulder-held framing, imperfect zoom, slow autofocus, exposure pumping around bright lights, washed-out colors, interlaced DV motion, mild tape noise and compression artifacts.    0.0–2.0s — HOOK: Begin already in the middle of the extraordinary interview. A nervous male TV reporter stands beside a tall, thin but biologically believable alien directly in front of the spacecraft. The reporter holds a wired news microphone toward it while the camera quickly zooms from the glowing ship to the alien’s detailed face. The alien has moist textured grey skin, subtle breathing, blinking black eyes and natural weight; it is not a costume and not cartoonish.    2.0–5.5s: In one continuous handheld take, the reporter looks up at the alien and asks seriously in English: “Why did you come to Earth? What are you looking for?” His delivery is cautious and professional. The cameraman briefly loses focus while reframing both faces, then corrects it. The alien silently considers the question for one awkward second while the ship hums behind them.    5.5–11.5s — DEADPAN PAYOFF: The alien slowly reaches into a small metallic pouch attached to its body and removes a slightly crumpled paper coupon. It holds the coupon up between two long fingers and answers in calm, perfectly understandable English with a strange dry voice: “I came to redeem this coupon. Twenty-piece Chicken McNuggets, with sweet-and-sour sauce. At McDonald’s.” Its face remains completely serious. The mouth movement matches only the alien’s dialogue.    11.5–15.0s — AFTERMATH: The reporter lowers the microphone slightly and stares at the alien in total disbelief. The camera performs an awkward accidental zoom onto the coupon, then back to the reporter’s confused face. The alien points matter-of-factly toward the distant town as if asking for directions. The cameraman tries to suppress a quiet laugh. The reporter finally mutters: “Right … okay.” Abrupt authentic tape-style cut.    AUDIO: clean English location dialogue but imperfect early-2000s microphone quality, light wind, wet grass under shoes, distant insects, spacecraft ventilation and electrical hum. No music, narration, trailer sound effects or laugh track. The humor comes entirely from the serious documentary tone and absurdly mundane answer.    CONTINUITY / NEGATIVES: one reporter, one alien, one cameraman and one spacecraft only; continuous reachable camera position; no impossible camera angles, duplicated people or aliens, morphing, floating, teleportation, cartoon CGI, glowing magical eyes, aggression, weapons, crowds, subtitles, on-screen text, changing coupon or changing microphone.
```

```text
UNIVERSAL MOTORCYCLE → HERO ROBOT
TRANSFORMATION CHARACTER SHEET MASTER PROMPT

Analyze the provided motorcycle photograph carefully and use the motorcycle itself as the absolute visual reference.

Do not assume a motorcycle model, color palette, body style, or mechanical configuration in advance.

FIRST, visually analyze the actual motorcycle shown in the uploaded photograph.

Automatically identify and preserve its most recognizable visual characteristics, including:

motorcycle type and overall silhouette,
body proportions,
primary and secondary colors,
painted body panels,
front and rear wheels,
wheel size and thickness,
tires,
wheel rims,
front fork,
rear suspension,
engine or motor components,
exhaust system,
frame,
fuel tank or central body structure,
seat shape and material,
handlebars,
mirrors,
headlight,
tail light,
turn signals,
front and rear fenders,
cargo box or luggage equipment if present,
windscreen if present,
footboard or foot pegs,
exposed cables,
mechanical joints,
decals and graphic placement,
surface scratches,
paint wear,
 dust,
aged materials,
and other distinctive physical details visible in the reference.

The final robot must clearly retain the visual DNA of THIS EXACT MOTORCYCLE.

A viewer should immediately think:

"That robot was transformed from that motorcycle."

==================================================
CHARACTER SHEET CONCEPT
==================================================

Create a cinematic transformation character sheet showing ONE motorcycle gradually transforming into ONE humanoid heroic robot.

Show the transformation as a clear physical progression:

STAGE 1:
Original motorcycle.

The motorcycle remains almost completely unchanged and clearly recognizable.

STAGE 2:
Early mechanical activation.

Small body panels separate slightly.

Mechanical locks release.

Suspension components shift.

Internal mechanical structures become visible.

The motorcycle must still remain approximately 80–90% recognizable.

STAGE 3:
Intermediate transformation.

The wheels reposition naturally.

The chassis begins extending.

Existing motorcycle components rotate, unfold, slide and reconnect.

The beginnings of humanoid legs, torso and arms become visible.

The motorcycle remains approximately 50–70% recognizable.

STAGE 4:
Advanced transformation.

The original motorcycle body panels become armor.

Wheels integrate naturally into the robot anatomy.

The exhaust becomes a recognizable mechanical armor component.

Handlebars, mirrors, lights, suspension, frame, seat, cargo equipment and other visible motorcycle components are redistributed logically across the robot.

The humanoid silhouette becomes dominant.

STAGE 5:
COMPLETE HERO ROBOT.

A magnificent full-body mechanical hero created entirely from the visual identity of the original motorcycle.

==================================================
TRANSFORMATION PHYSICS
==================================================

The transformation must look mechanically believable.

Every major motorcycle component should have a logical destination on the final robot.

Parts rotate around realistic hinges.

Panels slide along mechanical rails.

Frames extend through telescoping structures.

Suspension components become functional mechanical joints.

Existing motorcycle components become armor rather than disappearing.

Wheels remain physically recognizable.

The exhaust remains recognizable.

The original painted panels remain recognizable.

Distinctive motorcycle accessories remain recognizable whenever physically possible.

NO instant morphing.

NO liquid-metal transformation.

NO magical replacement.

NO random teleporting parts.

NO unexplained disappearance of major motorcycle components.

NO generic robot replacing the motorcycle.

The transformation should feel slow, heavy, deliberate and physically connected.
```

01 | 0–1.2s — ICE IMPACT
Extreme close-up of crystal-clear ice cubes shattering in a signature Coca-Cola glowing red environment. Ice water droplets and tiny ice particles fly toward the camera in dramatic slow motion. Strong backlighting creates sparkling highlights.

07 | 7.2–8.6s — HERO FORMATION

08 | 8.6–10s — FINAL HERO SHOT

NEGATIVE PROMPT: Blurry logo, distorted bottle, deformed typography, incorrect branding, extra logos, warped products, unrealistic liquid physics, duplicated bottles merging, low resolution, cartoon look, plastic-looking liquid, watermark, text artifacts.

The upper section must be instantly recognizable as real photography at a glance, without illustration or halftone rasterization. Use a clean, horizontal, crisp boundary between the top and bottom.

The lower section occupies approximately 52%–55%. Do not repaint the complete scene, and do not apply a halftone filter across the entire photo. First lock onto one main element that anchors location identification from the same photo, then extract 4–7 secondary elements, forming a total of 5–8 recognizable objects. Elements that can be extracted include building facades, towers, rooftops, window panes, signage silhouettes, human silhouettes, vehicles, boat hulls, sails, bridges, plants, stalls, road markings, or water trails; do not add regional symbols not present in the photo.

Turn each object separately into an independent photographic mask layer: preserve accurate silhouettes and identity anchors, then convert them into coarse black-and-white halftones, monochrome ink plates, partial knockouts, and coarse-grain silkscreen printing. Do not arrange objects evenly as moodboards, 3x3 grids, or detached cards.

Employ a full-bleed, high-impact secondary composition. The largest primary element occupies approximately 55%–95% of the lower section's height, allowing it to bleed boldly off any canvas edge; the second tier of architecture, figures, or vehicles occupies 30%–65%; the remaining elements serve as rhythmic connections. Use distinct scale disparities, front-to-back overlaps, edge cropping, partial interlocking, and directional echoes to establish clear foreground, midground, and background. The image should be dense yet orderly, appearing as though an old travel journal was re-engraved and re-plated, rather than an identical-composition replica of the full scene.

Run 1–2 rectangular or irregular spot-color blocks behind some of the objects to produce silkscreen overprinting and hierarchical separation; color blocks must not cover the entire background. Reserve approximately 15%–25% of continuous, low-information aged paper or a quiet solid-color field for typography and breathing room, but do not let the frame degrade into a sparse minimalist display.

Extract and compress colors from the input photo into 3–5 printing ink hues: warm ivory aged paper, the deepest dark brown or indigo from the photo, and 2–3 spot colors with the highest location recognizability. Express vintage magazine coarse halftones, halftone density shifts, paper fibers, ink starvation, squeegee rough edges, cutout ragged edges, and slight misregistration. Each object must remain identifiable and must not degenerate into meaningless texture.

In the continuous quiet area at the bottom, include only the following three lines of text:
"[1–3 English words location or theme title]"
"MASK PLATE [two-digit number]"
"[a 5–10 English word sentence of an observation derived from the photo facts]"

The title should use clearly legible bold condensed, vintage serif, or compressed sans-serif uppercase; the field and observation sentence should be smaller, yet still distinguishable in chat preview. The text should look printed onto paper using the same ink colors as the artwork, with slight ink starvation and registration deviation. All text must be grouped together in one block, must not obstruct human faces, vehicles, boat hulls, or structural architectural identity, and no other text should be generated.

Avoid: full-image halftone filters, repainting with identical cropping and scale, single landmark woodblock prints, extracting only 2–3 objects, regular grids, equal-size displays, scrapbook tape, solid background floods, excessive negative space, generic regional templates, cross-location mixing, transparent watercolor, cartoon style, smooth vectors, digital gradients, 3D collages, overly fine halftones, unlayered pileups, illegible tiny text, pseudo-Chinese characters, author names, signatures, brands, logos, URLs, QR codes, watermarks, and garbled text.

The most important rule: The lower section must convert multiple real objects from the same photo into mask halftone layers of varying colors and scales, reassembling them through overlapping, cropping, and interwoven color blocks into a brand-new travel montage; it must never simply print-filter the intact original image.

A sculpted costume half-mask covering the nose, mouth and chin, with a raised faceted nose bridge, high sweeping cheek edges and a pointed central chin. Glossy pearl-white angular plates form the broad front, bordered on both lower cheeks by recessed black panels with polished rose-gold edging and small metallic junction studs. A small triangular metallic inlay accents the nose bridge; the cheek panels taper back toward the ears. Soft black lining and a narrow adjustable rear elastic strap support the rigid shell.

Final worn state:
VIEW-CONDITIONAL BODY-SIDE MAP: front view — wearer-left is image-right and wearer-right is image-left; back view — wearer-left is image-left and wearer-right is image-right. In profiles, crossed limbs, or ambiguity, trace the named anatomical side continuously from its corresponding shoulder, hip, eye, or ear landmark as applicable. Apply the state only to the named anatomical side; never mirror, swap, or duplicate it.
- Face mask wearing: Wear the complete face mask centered over the lower face, placing its upper edge across the nose bridge and its lower edge beneath the chin so both nose and mouth are covered. Attach each original wearer-left and wearer-right support to its corresponding ear or head anchor. Do not rotate, offset, duplicate, omit, or redesign the mask. Change only the selected registered state and leave every unselected component and connection unchanged.

Character · Text / Typography · Abstract / Background · Published

**Summary:** A timecoded video prompt featuring a hand-drawn character dancing joyfully alongside text and doodles against a sketchbook-style background.

<img src="covers/2097520388326510672.jpg" alt="Image 1" width="480" />

**Prompt**

```text
CUT01 | 00:00–00:02.5 | Visuals: White sketchbook-like background. In the center of the screen stands a hand-drawn, rounded, minimalist main character. Round head, simple limbs, an approachable design with just tiny eyes and a mouth. Initially a slightly absentminded expression. Small handwritten words like "ふー" (phew), "ぼんやり" (spacing out), and "まだかな" (not yet?) drift around. In the background are faint dots, doodle circles, and short lines. | Camera: 50mm equivalent, front medium shot, slowly and gently pushing in. | Motion: The protagonist stands quietly, only slightly swaying their body. Not dancing yet. Line of sight shifts slightly left and right. | Lighting: Bright high-key. Soft light revealing a faint paper texture. | VFX: Rough wobble of hand-drawn lines, slight bleeding of ink, faint halftones. | BGM: Bright pop-electro begins. 150–160 BPM. Quietly starts with just light clicks, mallets, and a soft kick at the beginning. | SFX: "Whoosh" of a pen, subtle "poof". | Emotion: Still quiet, empty space of the beginning. | Transition: A small pink "とん" (tap) appears at the protagonist's feet, leading to the next CUT. CUT02 | 00:02.5–00:05.0 | Visuals: Colorful handwritten words "とん" (tap), "るん" (hum/skip), and "ぱっ" (pop) appear one after another at the protagonist's feet. Colors are pink, cyan, yellow, orange, lime, and purple. Hand-drawn stars, musical notes, and arrows begin to multiply in the surroundings. Background dots also become slightly darker. | Camera: 35mm equivalent, slightly pulled back framing showing full body. Light slide left and right. | Motion: The protagonist first taps with one foot ("とん"), then bounces their shoulders with "るん", and finally opens their arms slightly with "ぱっ". Still restrained, but clearly starting to dance. | Lighting: Bright and lighthearted. | VFX: Animation of text being written out as it appears, light afterimages, colorful sparks. | BGM: Hi-hats and claps are added. The beat comes forward, triggering the dance. | SFX: "とん" (tap), "るん" (hum), "ぱっ" (pop). | Emotion: A bit fun, mood starting to lift. | Transition: The "るん" at the feet bounces upward, circling around the protagonist toward the next CUT. CUT03 | 00:05.0–00:08.0 | Visuals: Handwritten words "わく" (excited), "にこっ" (smile), "くるっ" (twirl), "きらっ" (sparkle), "いいね" (nice) appear rhythmically around the protagonist. In the background, hand-drawn musical notes, lightning bolts, circled shapes, speech bubbles, and radial lines appear. The entire scene bursts into a colorful pop-art style all at once. | Camera: 28mm equivalent, lightly orbiting while tracking the full body. | Motion: Protagonist starts dancing in earnest. Stepping, swaying shoulders, swinging arms left and right, and finally spinning around with "くるっ". The surrounding text spins along with the rotation. | Lighting: Brightness where colors pop most vibrantly as the mid-section buildup. | VFX: Orbiting paths of rotating text, expanding/shrinking dots, comic-style sparks, energetic marker strokes. | BGM: Bass and rhythmic synth chops enter, raising tension by one level. The rhythm bounces, creating a visually satisfying groove for the dance. | SFX: "たんっ" (tap), "くるっ" (twirl), "きらっ" (sparkle), "にこっ" (smile). | Emotion: Fully becoming fun and lively. | Transition: A circle of colorful text forms around the spun protagonist, and that circle expands across the entire screen into the next CUT. CUT04 | 00:08.0–00:11.0 | Visuals: In sync with the protagonist's dance, the background itself begins to dance. Handwritten "るん♪", "わくわく" (thrilling), "ぱっ", "たんっ", "GO!" scatter across the entire screen; doodle arrows, musical notes, and stars bounce to the rhythm. The whole world looks as if "Today is dancing." | Camera: 24mm equivalent, slightly wide to show the whole picture, gently pushing in and out to the beat. | Motion: Protagonist takes two steps left and right, jumps, lands, and raises both arms. Background text and doodles simultaneously bounce up, down, left, and right, dancing along with the protagonist. | Lighting: High-key and pop, open and exhilarating brightness with a climactic feel. | VFX: Elastic deformation of hand-drawn lines, confetti-like text fragments, switching halftone dots, flashing radial burst lines. | BGM: Maximum peak excitement here. Synths open up, claps increase, and the beat bounces at its peak. | SFX: "ぽん！" (pop!), "たんっ！" (tap!), "しゃらん！" (shimmer!), "るん♪". | Emotion: Peak of heart-fluttering joy. | Transition: The dancing text gathers all at once around the protagonist, getting sucked into the center. CUT05 | 00:11.0–00:13.2 | Visuals: The colorful handwritten text that was dancing swirls into a vortex, momentarily assembling fragments of "もしも、" (what if), "今日が" (today), "踊ったら？" (danced?) in the center. The background doodles become somewhat organized, and the message begins to emerge. Protagonist in the center foreground enters the final wrap-up of the dance. | Camera: 40mm equivalent, center framing showing protagonist and text vortex, slowly pushing in. | Motion: Protagonist makes a small turn, moving right up to the moment of entering the final pose with one hand raised and one leg stepped forward. The text neatly and satisfyingly aligns while swirling. | Lighting: Grounded brightness, clean atmosphere toward the finale. | VFX: Hand-drawn text vortex, redrawn lines, soft glow, pop splatters. | BGM: Instruments briefly drop out here to create a break. A momentary "pause/anticipation" before the final message. | SFX: "Shurururu", "su-", "kyun". | Emotion: Anticipation, right before the finale pose. | Transition: The final stroke of text is drawn, leading to completion. CUT06 | 00:13.2–00:15.0 | Visuals: Large, colorful handwritten text "もしも、今日が踊ったら？" appears fully formed in the center of the screen. The text uses multicolor marker-style rendering with a thick black outline for solid legibility. Below it in small lettering: "るん♪". The protagonist strikes a fun final dance pose beside or in front of it with one leg lifted. Musical notes, stars, circles, and arrows float gently in the surroundings. | Camera: 50mm equivalent, static shot to present clearly. | Motion: Protagonist does one final subtle bounce, winks or smiles brightly. "るん♪" also bounces slightly alongside. | Lighting: Refreshing high-key, emphasizing lingering resonance. | VFX: Extremely subtle lingering particles, afterimages of hand-drawn lines, faint dot background. | BGM: A bright chord hits at the exact moment the message completes, landing cleanly with a pop, satisfying finish. | No dialogue | SFX: "ぽん♪" (pop♪). | Emotion: An uplifting, positive, and happy afterglow the moment viewing finishes. | Transition: Fade out leaving white space. Overall Direction Rules | Visuals: The protagonist is a "hand-drawn, rounded minimalist character," keeping a simple shape to ensure dance movements are easy to follow. Text serves as visual direction to express the protagonist's emotions and rhythm, structured so the world itself gradually starts dancing. | Color: A colorful pop-art palette based on vivid pink, cyan, yellow, orange, lime, and purple. The more positive the text, the more vibrant its color. | Motion: The protagonist's dance is small at first, light on its feet midway through, and firmly shown all the way to the final pose. Text details shift rapidly in 0.2 to 0.6-second units: bouncing, spinning, being drawn, scattering, and converging. | Typography: Prioritize a hand-drawn feel while displaying Japanese text accurately without corruption. Readability of the final copy "もしも、今日が踊ったら？" is top priority. | BGM: Bright, fast-paced pop-electro. Around 150–160 BPM. Quiet intro → mid-song acceleration → max climax → brief suspenseful pause near the end → clean, pleasant landing at the finish. | SFX: Writing sounds, pops, jumps, and bell-like sparkles inserted at key moments, cleanly synced with dance movements.
